sources.title: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics Releases Small, Cute & Open-Source ...
sources.snippet: Hugging Face's Pollen Robotics has introduced Microduck, a small biped robot designed as an open development platform for experimenting with physical AI, reinforcement learning and transferring robot behaviors from simulation into real hardware.

sources.snippet: Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face launch Microduck, a $399 open-source 25 cm biped trained with reinforcement learning in MuJoCo.

sources.title: Hugging Face Unveils Microduck, New Open-Source Biped AI Robot
sources.snippet: Hugging Face, an organisation known for its open-source artificial intelligence models, has unveiled a new biped robot named Microduck. This device is 25 centimetres tall, weighs 800 grams, and is priced at USD 399. Pre-orders for Microduck commenced on Aug. 27, with shipping anticipated before Christmas 2026.

sources.title: Meet Microduck, The $399 Programmable AI Robot | Ubergizmo
sources.snippet: Microduck marks the second hardware release from Hugging Face, following the Reachy Mini, a desktop-focused platform intended for conversational AI, computer vision models, and human-robot interaction research. In contrast to the research-centric focus of the Reachy Mini, Microduck offers a more lighthearted design and expanded styling options.

sources.title: Nvidia Teaches a $399 Duck Robot to Walk Using AI - TechRepublic
sources.snippet: Nvidia and Hugging Face show how the $399 Microduck robot learns to walk using AI simulation. Explore its hardware, training process, and availability.
